spots.name: Southeast Farallon Island
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 446 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L329116.

spots.name: Main Top
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 68 m (223 ft).

spots.name: Tower Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 74 m (243 ft).

spots.name: Arch Rock
spots.tip: A natural arch. Low side light at either end of the day brings out the rock texture; at night it can frame the Milky Way.

spots.name: Point Reyes, Whales Observation Point very good view
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
